# Doxygen Awesome

Unmodified documentation-only CSS from [Doxygen Awesome](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css),
version 2.5.0, commit `46483f1e5a70ffb9ecd3b82d0a1cd1b24edf13da`.
The two stylesheets and [MIT license](LICENSE) are pinned in `manifest.json`.
They are used only by `PORTALS_BUILD_DOCS` and copied into the HTML output.
Building or reading the documentation does not download theme resources.
Portals overrides live in `docs/diagrams.css`; upstream files are unchanged.
